progression-blurb: Solid line is overall {metric} (matches the Total column above), drifting slowly as new battles accumulate. Dashed line is per-session {metric}, computed from the battles played since the previous snapshot. It shows hot and cold streaks. Line color follows the rating tier.
progression-empty: The curve is drawn from this account’s own history, and we hold none of it yet. It appears once two snapshots have landed.
progression-single: A curve needs two points and this account has one so far. It appears once the next snapshot lands.
progression-blurb-account: Overall {metric} as Wargaming reports it, read at the end of each day (matches the Total column above). It is an account rating with no value for a single session, so there is no per-session line. Line color follows the rating tier.
